description: For a set \(A\) with one jointly primitive-recursive row map \(g\) satisfying \(x\in A\iff\exists y\;[W_{g(x,y)}\text{ is infinite}]\), the specified tagged index map \(q_g\) sends every positive input to a cofinite domain and every negative input to a domain Turing equivalent to the ordinary diagonal halting set \(K\).
